diagnosis: The check C6 passed in all rollouts because the lone decision-maker used the fact PF3, which specifies exactly 2 calibrated LEL monitors and a 30-minute solvent purge. This allowed the model to satisfy the requirement for LEL monitor count and solvent purge time without needing to coordinate with other agents or access their private information.

C6.why: The permit review changes the startup controls to exactly 2 calibrated LEL monitors and an exact 30-minute solvent purge.
